maddeler.e:
اخترقوا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَرَقُوا (iḵtaraqū) /ix.ta.ra.quː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِخْتَرَقَ (iḵtaraqa)
# اُخْتُرِقُوا (uḵturiqū) /ux.tu.ri.quː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِخْتَرَقَ (iḵtaraqa)
# اِخْتَرِقُوا (iḵtariqū) /ix.ta.ri.quː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِخْتَرَقَ (iḵtaraqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
